answers.how: The fish is about 220 px long and moves about 186 px/s. Its length is 220 × 0.67 / 186.
The fish spans about 80 px across its fins. Using the motion scale gives 80 × 0.67 / 186.
The fish moves about 93 px from 0.5 s to 1.0 s. Converting with 0.67 / 186 meters per pixel gives 0.335 m.
